record.question: The Home Ministry has appointed a Commission to study about the proposed state of Telegana under the Chairmanship of
record.explanation: Answer C: Justice Srikrisna. Justice B. N. Srikrishna chaired the committee constituted on 3 February 2010 to examine the Telangana demand and the demand for a united Andhra Pradesh. The printed spelling Srikrisna denotes that chairman. Historical/source note: The official body was a committee, and the name is B. N. Srikrishna; retain the source's wording and spelling. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/erelcontent.aspx?lang=2&reg=48&relid=57801. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
